snippet.title: HORDELORD - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist NOW! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3676260/Hordelord/

Hi-octane arena shooter where you face waves of nasty enemies. Use destructive weapons and high mobility to secure your spot on global leaderboards. Expect tight gunplay, satisfying kills, and meaningful upgrades.
